svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: 57 file tools: 38 run entirely in the browser (the file never leaves the device), 17 send the file to the server (processed in a sandboxed job, nothing kept), 2 are hybrid.
USER'S BROWSER (desktop or phone, installable PWA)
UI shell (HTML + CSS + vanilla JavaScript, no framework, no build)
index.html, app.js (tool modal, progress, downloads, routing /merge-pdf ...)
tools.js = catalogue of all 57 tools (options, accept types, run handler)
site.js search + nav, home-plus.js, theme.js, icons.js (own SVG icons),
tile-art.js + holo.css (3D cards), chains.js ("Keep going" + My Recipes)
page-board (thumbnail grid), sign-tool, edit-tool, scan-tool, crop-tool,
compare-tool, read-tools, image-tools, photo-tool, image-order, form-kit,
pdf-extras, form-fill, qr-tool, zip-tool, media-tool, privacy-view, feedback
Each tool either runs locally (below) or calls serverRequest(/api/...)
pdf-lib 1.17.1: merge, split, organize, rotate, remove pages,
watermark, page numbers, headers/footers, crop, resize, dark mode, sign,
edit, metadata, images to PDF, scan to PDF, n-up, booklet, bookmarks
JSZip 3.10: ZIP output. Runs off the main thread so the page never freezes
Thumbnails and previews, PDF to JPG/PNG, PDF to text (Markdown),
Compare PDFs (Myers word diff + pixel diff), extract images, find headings
Text source for Read Aloud, Summarize and Translate
WebAssembly engines (downloaded only when a tool needs them)
ffmpeg.wasm (31 MB): Compress Video, Video to MP3, Trim Audio/Video
libheif-js: HEIC/HEIF photos | libarchive.js: open RAR, 7z, TAR, GZ
Allowed by CSP "wasm-unsafe-eval" (no plain eval anywhere)
Canvas / OffscreenCanvas: image convert, resize to KB, exam photos, scan cleanup
Camera (getUserMedia): Scan to PDF, QR reader | jsQR + qrcode-generator, fontkit
Web Speech: Read Aloud | Chrome Translator + Summarizer: on-device AI
(Summarize falls back to an offline extractive summary in other browsers)
sw.js service worker + Cache Storage: browser tools work offline
localStorage: theme, My Recipes, recently used tools
Nothing about your files is stored
Privacy rule: browser tools read the file with FileReader and
write the result to a Blob download. No network request carries it.
Hybrid tools (browser first, server only for one step)
Compress Any File: images + Office files in browser, PDFs via /api/compress
Compress PDF to Exact Size: server levels, then browser JPEG re-render
Results can flow into the next tool with the "Keep going" bar (chains.js)
Caddy or nginx on the host,
non-root uid 10001 | read-only filesystem | tmpfs /tmp 2 GB | cap_drop ALL | no-new-privileges | 6 GB RAM | 512 pids
Async web server; --limit-concurrency 200, no server header
Middleware (runs before the body is read)
UploadLimit: 413 above 100 MB -> RateLimit: 60 server jobs / IP / hour (guards.py)
-> TrustedHost + CORS allow-list -> security headers, CSP, HSTS, /api no-store
Job slots = CPU count; waits up to 90 s for a slot, else 503 "server busy". Maps errors to 400/503/500
Sandboxed job process (one per upload, forked from a preloaded forkserver)
RLIMIT_AS 3 GB memory, 300 s CPU and wall clock, no core dumps. A hostile file can only crash its own job.
PyMuPDF (fitz) | pypdf | pikepdf (qpdf) | ReportLab | Pillow | pdfplumber
pdf2docx | python-docx | openpyxl | python-pptx | markdown | python-multipart
Zip and image bomb limits on every input; linked images in Office files are blocked
Tesseract OCR: English, German, French, Spanish + 12 Indian languages
OCRmyPDF (Python) drives Tesseract + Ghostscript for searchable PDFs
LibreOffice headless (soffice): Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODF -> PDF, two warm profiles
Windows only: Microsoft Office via COM in office_com_worker.py, 180 s limit
Converters write to a private temp folder in tmpfs /tmp, deleted when the job ends
Uploads and results live in memory only; responses carry Cache-Control: no-store
No database, no accounts, no file storage. Only feedback is persisted
Code is read-only inside the container
Runs in the browser, file stays on device
Languages: Python 3.11 (server), JavaScript ES2020 (browser, no build step), HTML + CSS, WebAssembly (vendored engines), Dockerfile + YAML (deploy). Licence AGPL-3.0.
